what: Ford builds trucks, vans and cars. The F-Series pickup is the best-selling vehicle in the United States and the main source of profit. Ford Pro sells and services commercial vans and trucks to businesses, and Ford Credit finances vehicle purchases.
customers: American truck and van buyers, commercial fleets and tradespeople, and buyers in Europe and other markets.
money: petrol and hybrid vehicles, including the F-Series
commercial vans and trucks plus service and software subscriptions
moat: The F-Series franchise, where loyalty and dealer service have held for decades, plus a commercial van business with repeat fleet relationships.
risks: It reported a large loss in the latest twelve months after warranty, recall and other charges
Electric vehicle operations have lost billions a year
Warranty and recall costs have been among the worst in the industry
Tariffs on imported parts raise costs
opportunities: Ford Pro earns high margins and is growing through service and software
Analysts see about 30% upside from current levels
Cash of about $34 billion gives it room to absorb a difficult period
watch: Ford Pro profit, warranty costs, and losses in the electric vehicle unit.
